大家好，我们是蒸汽满满工作室。
我们的第二款真人互动影视作品《美女，请别影响我成仙》将于[b]2025年6月20日[/b]发售。

很感谢大家的支持，我们今后一定会制作更好的产品。

notes.content:

Anyone who achieves their desired level on the wish list can trigger the "Live Sky Quest" lottery ceremony, and the Heavenly Way will bestow opportunities as gifts!

Ask Immortal Stone: Become Immortal CDK+2 character seals+1 female lead card
Treasure Box: 4 character seals+2 female lead cards+1 character bar
Avenue Inheritance: 5 character seals+3 female lead cards+2 character bars
Immortal Treasure: CDK for Immortal Creation+Complete Set of Character Seals+4 Female Lead Cards+3 Character Bars

[h3]【Activity Rules】[/h3]
1. The same account can only participate in this activity once. Search for the game name on Steam to add a ticket;
2. IDs that have not been added to the wish list will be disqualified from participation once discovered;
If the content filled in is unrelated to the theme of this event, it will be considered an invalid reply and will not qualify for the reward;
4. Extraction method: Live streaming online random number random selection
5. Award collection time: before 23:59 on August 31st. Failure to do so will result in disqualification from the award;
6. The final interpretation of the event belongs to the official.

notes.title: Dongfang Zhou, Yi Chengxian: "God bless，or Goddess"
notes.content:
﻿God bless，or Goddess "is about to participate in Steam Oriental Culture Week, and discounts are currently available! Let's unlock a new way of learning together: learning to cultivate immortality!

God bless，or Goddess "has officially landed on the Steam store page today! And the first product  PV was exposed, officially announced for global release on June 20th, inviting you to laugh and become a fairy road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912835/4611285b3a3a5491c80adb5669a7e0f2b29749d9.png[/img]

[h3]Eastern Zhou "Xiu Xian" Check in: Study! Cultivate immortality! Or 'Shameful Immortal'[/h3]

You, Lin Fan, the owner of the Pure Yang Spirit Root that is difficult to encounter for a thousand years, the only male cultivator of the Crane Illusion Sect, should have been the chosen son of the cultivation world, until you discovered that the real "crossing tribulation" was not thunder punishment, but a thousand tribulation with the young ladies of the sect.
In the first person perspective game, you will embark on your own immortal adventure in "madness, laughter, playfulness, and ridicule", including an unreliable master, an unpredictable senior sister, a second senior sister who confuses my mind, an ancient and eccentric nephew, a beautiful and charming saintly maiden, and a fragile sister-in-law. To break through the realm and become immortal with the imperial sword, while also guarding the pure yang and keeping the roots!
On June 20th, the Immortal Gate will open for a first person immersive cultivation adventure waiting for you to experience!
>>>[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545990/_/]Add to Steam wishlist now and participate in the Eastern Week cultivation check-in![/url]
